editorial:
Imagine being the secret talent behind someone else's fame. You follow Adèle and her husband Ferdinand as they move from the countryside to the big city of Paris. Ferdinand is a painter, but he is not actually that great on his own. Adèle is the one who secretly fixes his paintings and adds the magic touches that make them look professional. It is a sad but interesting look at a woman who gives up her own dreams just to make sure her husband succeeds in the art world.

The acting feels very real, and you can really feel the tension between the couple as Ferdinand gets more famous while Adèle stays hidden. Some parts move a bit slow, but the emotional payoff is worth it if you like stories about hidden secrets. It is a great pick for a quiet night in when you want something that makes you think about fairness and love.
endingExplained: In the end, Ferdinand becomes a huge success, but he completely forgets that Adèle was the one who actually made the art great. He takes all the credit and the money while she remains invisible. The movie wraps up with a sad realization that their love was destroyed by his greed and her silence. She ends up lonely and broken, proving that success means nothing if you lose your soul and your partner to get it.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about secret talents and historical drama.
